CR19_PlayerHunt_Event_Spring_2020.HuntDescription: Complete a mission comprised of 3 timed segments to earn carrot chips you can spend in the Springtide Shop. First, gather unhatched pufflehop eggs for study. Next, round up hatched pufflehops into the transport pen. Finally, defend your collected pufflehops from hungry styxians until your airship returns.
